Annotation guidelines with three-tier labels (yes, to some extent, no) for each of the eight dimensions.

Each dimension was annotated using a three-tier labeling system (see Figure and Table 4). For instance, the 'mistake identification' dimension employed the following labels: (i) yes, (ii) to some extent, and (iii) no.

overall_notes: The paper is well-focused on NLG evaluation for dialogue generation in educational contexts. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of model names (Phi-3), separation of metrics from LLM judges, and consolidation of redundant descriptions. The paper clearly uses automatic metrics (traditional NLG metrics), LLM judges (Prometheus2, Llama-3.1-8B), and human evaluation with a well-defined taxonomy.
